description: Fixed 20-case recall benchmark for GET /api/memories?q=. Each case is a query plus either the exact set of keys a correct surface must return (expectKeys) or an expected refusal (expectRefusal: zero results). Cases 1-2 reproduce the live-API observations of 2026-10-27 verbatim (see their notes). Unanswered cases (empty result where a key was expected, or a request error) count as unanswered, never as correct. The runner seeds `seed` into a scratch instance before measuring; expected keys are cross-checked against the seed corpus so the fixture cannot silently reference memories it never planted.

seed.content: Last successful scheduler tick completed at 04:17 UTC; the fleet cooldown window reset to 900 seconds.
Scheduler state snapshot: lane weights, tick counters, and dispatch pointers.
Board census counted forty one lanes derived from the scheduler database; JSONL boards are canonical.
Git worktree hygiene: reap only zero-commit branches after verifying ahead count and clean status.
Rebuild the embeddings cache after any provider rotation; stale vectors silently poison ranking.
The embedding cache directory is gitignored and keyed by provider id plus content hash.
Cost ledger truth comes from state.db session estimates, never from tick sticker prices.
Pre-commit secret scanning uses gitleaks with a tuned allowlist for false positives.
Tailscale ACLs and subnet router setup for fleet hosts, including tag ownership.
Board storage moved from duckdb caches to git-backed jsonl event logs; sqlite remains for scheduler state.
The formatting gate runs prettier check mode on every touched file before commit.
Nightly restic snapshots ship to object storage; the restore drill is verified quarterly.
The weekly digest aggregates board events into a narrative report for review.
Gateway restart procedure: drain connections, swap the binary, verify health endpoints.
CI triage classifies each red run as flake, sibling breakage, or real regression.
Model routing prefers plan lanes and only falls back to payg providers at the tail.
Vacuuming the state database reclaims free pages after heavy pruning of old rows.
Reciprocity is the felt weight of give and take between an agent and its operator.
The alerting net pages the operator when scheduler stalls or queue depth grows.
Incident review: orphaned worker scopes starved the host disk during parallel waves.
The nightly e2e rotation exercises UI, API, and database wiring on seeded fixtures.
Keyword sidecar rebuilds are bounded and single-flight per namespace under an advisory lock.
Draft changelog entry covering the recall benchmark fixture, runner, and scheduled workflow.
Runbook for the recall quality measurement task: fixture corpus, runner harness, exit gates.

cases.note: Live-API observation 2026-10-27: GET /api/memories?namespace=coding-hermes&q=cooldown returned 2 records — /sync/coding-hermes/last-success (relevant) plus an unrelated scheduler-state note (noise). Expected: exactly the cooldown memory.

Live-API observation 2026-10-27: q=zzzznothinglikethis returned 3 records including /project/coding-hermes/board-census — a query with no possible match returned MORE rows than a real term. Expected: refusal (zero results).
Both seeded memories are genuinely about the embedding cache; a correct surface returns both and nothing else (FTS stems embedding/embeddings to the same root).
Ticket-id tokenization case: digit-mapped search text must make an id that lives in the KEY (not the content) findable.
Multi-token AND case: only the last-success memory carries both tokens; several distractors carry scheduler alone.
Morphology case: 'snapshot' must also match the plural 'snapshots' (backup-restore); both memories are genuinely snapshot-related.
Absent-topic refusal: a real English word with no possible match in the corpus.
Stopword-only query: every token is an FTS stopword, so there is nothing to match; a correct surface refuses instead of returning the whole namespace.
Well-formed but absent ticket id (digit-mapped tokens) must refuse.
Multi-token AND case: weekly-digest and jsonl-over-sqlite carry 'board' but not 'census'.
